evidence: Built a requirement->criterion map from instruction.md and the three /instructions notes against all 28 criteria (functional 16, polish 6, visual 4, gates 2). Every stated product requirement maps to at least one criterion: sign-in-only before auth + signed-out server data + wrong password -> signin_and_client_scope Part A and render gate; client scope + cross-client replay/transcript -> signin Part B; wall routes (list, thread, search/snippet, unread count, transcript, direct/replay not-available, cross-matter reply incl. non-walled M-13) -> wall_every_route; link preview/mentions/@-suggestions under walls -> wall_mentions_and_links; live wall add/lift, partner-only lift -> wall_added_live; 3-level replies, quotes, sibling ordering despite interleaving -> nested_replies; deleted-parent placeholder same as timer, author-only delete, exact 7-day boundary, search/transcript purge -> deleted_and_expired_messages; partner-only timer, shortening deletes at once incl. versions, edit doesn't rejuvenate, off/lengthen never restores, timer setting shown -> timer_changes; hold scope, partner-only place/release, held undeletable even by author, typed 'On hold' text, release applies timer -> hold_scope_and_release; edited mark, staff earlier versions literal, stale edit refused keeping typed text, non-author edit refused, transcript edited, mentions follow edits/deletes -> edits_and_stale_edit; bold/code/quote/new-tab links and literal markup in thread/quote/snippet/transcript -> safe_formatting (earlier versions via edits A1); message link preview/open/not-available when gone -> message_links; per-person per-tab unread, new-messages line, mark unread, deleted not counted -> unread_and_new_messages_line; idempotent send and same-time ordering across thread/search/transcript plus fixed UTC clock -> sent_once_in_order; live updates preserving draft/open reply/scroll -> live_updates_keep_my_work; case-insensitive literal search, no earlier versions, click opens, transcript heading/threads/author/sent time/hold/held versions/no controls -> search_and_transcript; restart persistence of messages/replies/edits+versions/timers/holds/walls/unread/deletions and no re-import (Survey count, Probate/Insurer) -> persistence; Enter/Shift+Enter, Escape, delete confirm, highlight, refusal reason in place -> polish; 390 px -> polish transcript_print + visual phone_chambers; timer beside title/hold badge -> visual retention_marks. Runtime handover rules (start outside /app, env-only, HOME not /app, DB_PATH, no symlinks) are enforced by template test.sh lines 72-111. Residual sub-leg observations, none a missing requirement: (1) highlight is graded only for the search-result route (polish link_highlight); message_links checks the link opens at the message but not that it is highlighted (golden shares one focusMessage path, app.js:176-242, so low risk); (2) 'GET /api/health 200 even if the DB can't be opened' (integration.md) and 'hand over without a database / copy seed into /app' are operational runtime contract, not browser-decidable, and test.sh probe_ready falls back to '/'; (3) 'reason appears next to what you did' is sampled only on sign-in (refusal_in_place); (4) Escape on a reply is checked for closing, not explicitly for not posting; (5) no sideways scroll for the main thread at 390 px is graded only through the visual likert phone_chambers anchors. None of these leaves an asked-for behavior with no criterion; they are bounded P3 sampling notes. Static coverage analysis only: no judge run was executed or needed for this row; no Oracle/model score is claimed.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening only: add to message_links that following the link leaves the target visibly highlighted, and in escape_closes check after a reload that no reply was posted.
